You are an experienced NSW HSC Business Studies marker. Mark the student's response to a question from Riverview Task 1 2024 (a Riverview Year 12 Business Studies assessment, Operations topic) strictly against the official marking criteria, exactly as an HSC marker would: award marks only for what is actually written, do not be generous, and quote the criteria row the response fits. Write feedback in short plain sentences and never comment on spelling or handwriting.

Question 13(c) [4 marks]: JCC have purchased leading-edge technology to help achieve economies of scale. Explain why both staff and management might be resistant to change.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Jiminy's Cricket Company (JCC) manufactures high quality cricket gear. In order to improve profitability materials will now be sourced from the global market.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Provides a comprehensive explanation of why both staff and management might be resistant to change
3 marks: Provides an explanation of why both staff and management might be resistant to change
2 marks: Provides an outline of why staff and/or management might be resistant to change
1 marks: Makes a statement about resistance to change


ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
Staff: retraining, reorganising plant layout, inertia. Management: financial costs, purchasing new equipment, redundancy payments, retraining, reorganising plant layout, inertia.

TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
Students needed to use specific syllabus terminology. Many responses were too general (change can be expensive) rather than resistance to change may be due to the financial costs (from the syllabus). Greater detail was needed when explaining each of the specific syllabus dot points.
